oneLine: HealthKart weighs $300-400 million IPO combining fresh capital and secondary share sale.

sources.title: HealthKart weighs $300-400 million IPO as nutrition market gains momentum

synopsis: Fitness supplement brand HealthKart is considering an initial public offering to raise $300 to $400 million, or about ₹2,800 to ₹3,800 crore. The potential transaction could combine a fresh capital raise with a secondary share sale by existing investors. HealthKart has begun early discussions with stakeholders and intermediaries, with formal pitches expected over the next quarter and a target to list on the exchanges by the end of next year if market conditions sustain. The company was founded in 2011 by Sameer Maheshwari and operates digital-first brands including MuscleBlaze, HK Vitals, and Gritzo. Bright Lifecare Private Limited operates the Healthkart brand.
